reading.body:
Moveworks's listed product is Moveworks, categorized under enterprise ai platforms & agent orchestration, with employee support automation as the function this data names first.

The data also tags Moveworks with IT service desk agent and enterprise-grade access controls, description of what the product does rather than how well it does it.

Moveworks sits at the application layer here, a product built on top of underlying compute rather than a claim on the compute itself, so this entry does not speak to the buildings or power behind it. Beyond the category, the product name, and this short list of tags tied to moveworks.com, the data carries no user counts, revenue, funding, or headcount, so nothing here supports a claim about Moveworks's scale or trajectory.

profile_text.body:
Moveworks describes itself as an AI Assistant platform for an entire workforce, used to find answers and automate tasks end to end across business applications. The company says the platform works through chat, web, intranet, portals, and mobile, supports more than 100 languages, and can search user-generated content across systems including Slack, OneDrive, Google Drive, SharePoint, Confluence, Outlook, and more than 50 others. It also describes a partnership with ServiceNow, which it says combines the two products to deliver employee support.

The company's stated core technology is the Moveworks Reasoning Engine, which it describes as an agentic AI system that orchestrates enterprise-ready LLMs and built-in tools so AI agents can understand, plan, execute, and adapt to requests. Moveworks says it offers hundreds of plugins and connectors, integration frameworks, analytics for tuning, and low-code or vibe-code tool builders for AI agents, with access controls. It says the platform requires no model tuning or prompt chaining and delivers return on investment within weeks. The site states that Moveworks was named a Challenger in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Artificial Intelligence Applications in IT Service Management, and cites a report finding that 78% of executives report major operational transformation. Customer material on the site includes a healthcare organization describing 300,000 colleagues and 185 million people served, a quote from Shrini Arole of Toyota, and a description of Micron connecting an AI front door powered by Moveworks to ServiceNow's autonomous workflows.

The company is headquartered in Mountain View. Its product listing describes employee support automation, an IT service desk agent, and enterprise-grade access controls.
